business_summary: Satellogic Inc. is a US, NASDAQ-listed (SATL) Earth-observation company operating a constellation of small satellites for low-latency multispectral imagery. Its documented rapid-response imagery, used after floods and the 2023 Derna dam collapse in Libya, is the mapped exposure to the tibet-mega-dam chain's riparian-risk-monitoring link.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only (cash_conversion writes only fcf_margin, valuation writes market_cap and price_to_sales). INFERRED covers figures computed from companyfacts or the market store's quality.derived block with the derivation named in each basis (margins, cash_conversion, valuation x2). NULL covers growth (only 3 fiscal years on file), leverage, both quality scores and both reverse-DCF fields, all traced to a missing total_debt, long_term_debt or cost_of_revenue field in companyfacts rather than judgement.
